requirements.statement: Default token location, access expiry, and cookie CSRF setting remain unchanged.
A list containing a supported token location remains accepted.
A list containing an unsupported token location is rejected with ValidationError.
Set and tuple inputs containing supported token locations remain accepted.
Every item in configured token locations, denylist checks, and CSRF methods is validated.
Strict boolean, integer, and string configuration fields do not accept unrelated coercions.
Configured strings are trimmed and fields that require content reject empty or whitespace-only values.
Optional configuration fields preserve their existing explicit None behavior.
Boolean True is rejected for access and refresh expiry configuration.
Boolean False disables the exp claim for access and refresh tokens.
Integer seconds and timedelta values preserve token expiry duration.
Supported CSRF method names supplied as a list are normalized to uppercase.
Invalid configuration values raise ValidationError and an invalid callback return type raises TypeError.
A Pydantic model returned by the configuration callback remains accepted.
A valid access token authorizes the protected route and preserves the subject.
A protected header-auth route rejects a request with no authorization header.
A refresh token cannot authorize a route requiring an access token.
A token signed with a different secret is rejected.
An enabled denylist rejects matching access tokens and permits nonmatching tokens.
A trimmed custom header name with no header prefix remains usable for authentication.
Cookie authentication on protected methods enforces a matching CSRF double-submit token.
The migration uses native Pydantic v2 configuration and validation APIs without pydantic.v1 or skipped validation.
